handoff.objective: Implement and rigorously inspect F5, F7 for the user-requested same-day P-256 research pass.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the specified algebra and construction work on the fixed published fields, and which exact solver/cost obligations remain.
constraints: Implementation validation and exact mathematical screening only; no official hypothesis or goal transition, no performance advantage claim.
Use published field and subgroup constants. Constructed positives certify correctness only. No private user targets.
Preserve every failed attempt and command. Distinguish software validation from prospective scientific trials.
Write only assigned track folders; no git commits, no shared edits, no PR mutations.
Keep all files under 64 KiB where practicable; split deterministic certificates by case. Do not discard data to meet a limit.
Include source, machine-readable check receipts, derivations, report.md and editable diagram.svg. Root renders aggregate PDF.
deliverables: Executable exact checks and source with reproducible commands.
Track-specific report separating derived facts, checked cases, assumptions and unmeasured quantities.
Machine-readable result.json with status, checks, limitations and next decisive step.

inference.runtime: native Codex subagent; inherited model; runtime binding unprobed

completion_gate: All declared implementation checks have terminal outcomes and exact commands.
No general solver or complexity claim inferred from finite checks.
handoff.return_format: Paths, check counts, concrete findings and remaining mathematical obligations.
